wa_city_park.notes: Free grade / pitch answer: the hard free climbing is ONE pitch, P1 (~35 m, bolt ladder start into a pin-scarred tips splitter), 5.13d (theCrag) / 5.13c/d (Alpinist) / 5.13c (Rakkup); the full line is 4 pitches (P2 5.10b, P3 ~5.10, P4 5.9+). Most free ascents stop at the P1 anchor. fa set strips the pasted 'FFA: Todd Skinner, 1986' (already in ffa). Catalog: wa_city_park_p2 (5.10b) and wa_city_park_bolt_ladder (5.10b sport) are separate rows for parts of this line, mirroring MP's separate entries - owner call. Pitch_detail P1 note 'historically graded America's hardest crack' is unverified. Rack: nuts and cams down to 00 (Alpinist, MP). Ascent history: Skinner and Herr used pre-placed gear; Mikey Schaefer made the first redpoint placing gear on lead (Alpinist 2005, climbing-history 2006 - year disagrees).
